faq.q: How do I make a video that sells a product?
faq.a: Paste the product link. The page is read, a script is written, you pick visuals and an avatar, and you get a clip you can publish to TikTok or Meta or download with no watermark.

faq.q: How do I create product videos with AI?
faq.a: Give a product link, pick a style and an avatar, then approve or edit the script. Scenes, a human-sounding voiceover and captions are added, and you can run a batch of versions for a test.

faq.q: How long should a product video be?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. A shorter clip fits a feed. Use 15 or 30 seconds when the action needs more of the motion on screen. Credits are 24, 40, 60 or 120.

faq.q: Can AI make a solid product demo?
faq.a: Yes. Combine an avatar who explains the feature, shots of the product in use, and extra footage, without booking a live shoot.

faq.q: How does a product link become a video?
faq.a: The product page is read for images, the title, the description and the features. A script is written from those selling points and paired with the visuals and an avatar.

faq.q: Can I customize the product video?
faq.a: Yes. Edit the script, swap avatars, change scenes or backgrounds, pick a track from the music library, set brand colors and add your logo in the built-in editor. You can also voice the script in another language.

faq.q: How is an AI product video different from a filmed one?
faq.a: You skip the shoot, you pay in credits you see first, and you can make another version from the same link. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. A failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: How do I keep the video on brand?
faq.a: Add your logo and colors, pick a voice that fits, and edit the script until the line sounds like your shop. An API can start the same job from your own tools.

actor_scene_picker.title: Choose an AI Presenter
actor_scene_picker.lead: Pick a generated presenter and a setting. The person on screen is an AI avatar, not a customer. The clip can include a script, a voiceover and captions.

cta.prompt: Show the uploaded product in use with the chosen avatar. Write a short script, add a human-sounding voiceover and captions, and keep the product's shape, color and label as in the photo.

steps.sourceAlt: Your product: a ceramic mug filling the frame on a pure white background.
steps.prompt: Show one clear action in a bright room, with an avatar and a short script about that action. Keep the shape, color and label as in the photo. Add a voiceover and captions.

picker.title: Sample Product Videos
picker.lead: Open one if you want a similar action, avatar and script.

cards.label: Umbrella opens for coverage
cards.prompt: Hands open the compact umbrella on a rainy sidewalk and stop when the canopy is fully open. Keep the umbrella's shape and color as in the photo. Add a short voiceover and captions.

cards.label: Folding bike hinge opens
cards.prompt: Hands unfold the compact bicycle once and pause with the central hinge fully open. Keep the bike's shape and color as in the photo. Add a short voiceover and captions.

cards.label: Desk lamp switches on
cards.prompt: A hand presses the desk lamp switch once. Warm light spreads across the desk, then the lamp stays on. Keep the lamp's shape and color as in the photo. Add a short voiceover and captions.

cards.label: Drawer trays slide into place
cards.prompt: Hands slide the divided trays into an open drawer and stop when the compartments line up. Keep the drawer's shape and color as in the photo. Add a short voiceover and captions.

cards.label: Travel charger packs away
cards.prompt: Hands coil the cable and pack the compact charger into a fabric travel pouch, then close the pouch. Keep the charger's shape and color as in the photo. Add a short voiceover and captions.

cards.label: Laptop sleeve opens for fit
cards.prompt: Hands open the padded laptop sleeve and slide a laptop halfway in, so the fit is visible. Keep the sleeve's shape and color as in the photo. Add a short voiceover and captions.

cards.label: Lunchbox latch clicks shut
cards.prompt: Hands close the divided lunchbox and press the side latch once, until the seal is shut. Keep the lunchbox's shape and color as in the photo. Add a short voiceover and captions.
